excerpt: New Capability Thresholds: We have added a new capability threshold related to CBRN development, which defines capabilities that could substantially uplift the development capabilities of moderately resourced state programs.

excerpt: We have also disaggregated our existing AI R&D capability thresholds, separating them into two distinct levels (the ability to fully automate entry-level AI research work, and the ability to cause dramatic acceleration in the rate of effective scaling) and provided additional detail on the corresponding Required Safeguards.

excerpt: Iterative Commitment: We have adopted a general commitment to reevaluate our Capability Thresholds whenever we upgrade to a new set of Required Safeguards.

excerpt: ASL-3 Security: This update excludes both sophisticated insiders and state-compromised insiders from the ASL-3 Security Standard. Previously, only "highly sophisticated state-compromised insiders" were explicitly excluded.
paraphrase: The May 2025 update broadens exclusions from the ASL-3 Security Standard to cover both sophisticated insiders and state-compromised insiders, versus only highly sophisticated state-compromised insiders before.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: We will implement robust insider risk controls to mitigate most insider risk, but consider mitigating risks from highly sophisticated state-compromised insiders to be out of scope for ASL-3.

excerpt: The model capabilities and threat models corresponding with the ASL-3 Security Standard do not warrant protection against either group: the CBRN-3 threat models entail large numbers of users having access to unguarded models (which is more likely to occur through a universal jailbreak than via model theft),
paraphrase: The rationale is that CBRN-3 threat models involve many users accessing unguarded models more likely via jailbreak than theft, so protection against these insider groups is not warranted.

excerpt: and the relatively small number of employees who might be capable of model theft does not significantly affect the risk level.
paraphrase: The small number of employees capable of model theft does not meaningfully change the risk level.

excerpt: For AI R&D-4, the threat models generally do not depend on model weight theft and instead entail AI systems engaging in autonomous internal sabotage.
paraphrase: For AI R&D-4, threat models rely on autonomous internal sabotage rather than weight theft.
